children: Royale Energy is current with SEC reporting, has resumed trading on OTC Pink and has begun an OTCQB application.
Completed previously delinquent periodic filings and is now current with SEC reporting obligations.
Trading of common stock has resumed on the OTC Pink market, restoring market access for shareholders.
Initiated application process to be quoted on the OTCQB to improve market visibility and investor access.
Board continues Strategic Review with Roth Capital Partners to evaluate alternatives to strengthen the company.
Plans to provide an operational update on oil and natural gas activities within the next few weeks.
